queries_run: Airbnb China trade restriction OR export control OR entity list 2026

findings.claim: ABNB 10-K FY2025 將關稅列為影響消費者可選支出（休閒旅遊）的宏觀風險；MD&A 稱至今對業務無重大影響，未來不確定。
findings.excerpt: To date, these conditions have not had a material impact on our business, results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition; however, the impact in the future of these macroeconomic and geopolitical conditions on our business, results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition is uncertain and will depend on future developments that we may not be able to accurately predict.

findings.claim: ABNB 10-K 載明須遵守 OFAC 等制裁法規，未來在主要業務地區的制裁可能對業務造成重大影響（制裁，非商品出口管制）。
findings.excerpt: Future sanctions in key business areas could materially impact our business, results of operations, and financial condition.

note: 搜尋未見 ABNB 被列入出口管制或 Section 232 的來源；平台業態無實體商品供應鏈，關稅僅經消費需求間接傳導（2025 年新聞摘要稱 4 月關稅衝擊曾使訂房下滑，未取得可逐字原文，未列入 findings）。
